entities.summary: Shinichi Osawa (b. 1967-02-07, Otsu) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Otsu and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, composers & musicians, asia.
